title: Knives Are Out in the White House

claims.claim: Republican losses occurred on Tuesday night in the midterm elections.

evidence.quote: President Donald Trump’s aides were reeling from the scale of Republican losses on Tuesday night

claims.claim: George W. Bush pushed out defense secretary Donald Rumsfeld after the GOP lost both chambers in 2006.

evidence.quote: Recalling how then-president George W. Bush pushed out defense secretary Donald Rumsfeld after the GOP lost both chambers in 2006

claims.claim: Vice president JD Vance and secretary of state Marco Rubio started requesting their own intelligence briefings this spring.

evidence.quote: a number of top officials, including vice president JD Vance and secretary of state Marco Rubio this spring started requesting their own intelligence briefings to get a more somber assessment of the situation.

The presentations had been so glowing, sources say, that a number of top officials, including vice president JD Vance and secretary of state Marco Rubio this spring started requesting their own intelligence briefings

claims.claim: Out of 14 key districts that got redrawn this cycle, Republicans won just one race in Texas and one race in Tennessee.

evidence.quote: Out of 14 key districts that got redrawn this cycle, Republicans won just one race in Texas and one race in Tennessee

claims.claim: Trump endorsed Ken Paxton in Texas and Darline Graham in South Carolina for key Senate races.

evidence.quote: Many of the candidates in key Senate races were people that Trump had chosen and endorsed, including the scandal-plagued Republican state attorney general Ken Paxton in Texas and the inexperienced Darline Graham, sister of the late senator Lindsey Graham, in South Carolina.

claims.claim: In North Carolina, former RNC chair Michael Whatley was defeated by Democratic Roy Cooper after Trump primaried Thom Tillis earlier this year.

evidence.quote: And in North Carolina, the former RNC chair Michael Whatley was defeated resoundingly by the Democratic Roy Cooper—but only after Trump primaried the popular incumbent Thom Tillis earlier this year.

claims.claim: The newsletter containing this information is Hugo Lowell’s Inner Loop.

evidence.quote: This is an edition of Hugo Lowell’s Inner Loop newsletter.
